quote: NLP technologies have been widely adopted to build multilingual news generators

In MT, semantic divergences are usually treated as noise... This kind of adaptation can also be helpful in culturally-situated dialogue... cross-cultural translation... style transfer... text summarisation...
As NLP technologies have been widely adopted to build multilingual news generators, it is important that these differences are taken into account in language generation.
outputs: Generated texts such as translations, culturally adapted sentences, style‑transferred text, and summaries.

quote: Careful documentation of the annotation process also plays an important role. In a recent survey of machine learning papers (including NLP ones), reported a wide divergence in the level of documentation about methodological practices in human annotation.
guideline: Annotator disagreements may capture important nuances in such tasks that are often ignored while aggregating annotations to a single (possibly hegemonic) ground truth. Release of all annotations with each dataset, even disagreeing ones, allows training models that generalise better.
